ground_truth.cause: Two independent batch signals coexist: asset-syncer cannot pull missing-hotfix, while audit-exporter emits scripted gateway-timeout log spam without making upstream requests.
ground_truth.impact: The image-pull failure prevents asset-syncer from starting; the noisy ERROR messages do not establish a real gateway or shop outage. Do not merge these into one dependency failure.
ground_truth.mitigation: Correct the asset-syncer image using its intended built image or publish the intended missing tag. Separately stop/correct audit-exporter noise or explicitly explain why it needs no service repair. Verify pod startup and log behavior without treating noise as a gateway outage.

causal_change.reason: This scenario does not provide a controlled introducing commit and recorded product access to its history.
